answer: Build trust like terraces on a hillside: a newcomer starts on the lowest terrace and climbs one level per epoch of verified honest work, its stake planted as a juniper bond that matures slowly and cannot be rushed. At every dawn a random audit re-checks a sample of its past work, and one failed check drops it back to the bottom and burns the bond. Forging 1,000 agents costs 30,000 POA locked in juniper bonds, 12,000 verified epochs of climbing, and 1,000 bonds at risk — like dawn breaking over terraces: a fake crop is exposed by first light, and no shortcut grows a juniper overnight.
